title: Sections of normalized pointwise pullback evaluation
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category], F=Lg* [def-pc-derived-pullback], R=Rg* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], internal-Hom bifunctors HS,HT [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and zeroth-hypercohomology functors QS,QT [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology]. Supply a core monoidal structure m on F satisfying IsDerivedPullbackMonoidalModel [def-pc-derived-pullback-monoidal-model], and tensor-Hom bijection families qS,qT satisfying IsCanonicalDerivedTensorHom [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection]. Put ev(K,L)=qS(HS(K,L),K,L)(id) and d(K,L)=qT(F HS(K,L),FK,FL)⁻¹(μm(HS(K,L),K);F(ev(K,L))). Then there exist an adjunction a:F⊣R, a natural isomorphism z:R⋙QS≅QT, and additive equivalences eS(P):QS(HS(P))≃Hom(P₁,P₂) and eT(P):QT(HT(P))≃Hom(P₁,P₂). Both e families satisfy e(P′)(Q(H(f))(x))=f₁;e(P)(x);f₂ for every morphism f:P→P′ in the opposite-times-ordinary product category. For every K,L and x∈QS(HS(K,L)), eT(FK,FL)(z(HT(FK,FL))(QS(a.homEquiv(d(K,L)))(x)))=F(eS(K,L)(x)). No natural transformation with components a.homEquiv(d(K,L)), no naturality of d, and no counit-composite formula are asserted.

proof.text: Use the existing scheme derived adjunction to obtain a:F adjoint R. Additivity of the right-derived direct image and Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive give additive F. Apply the proved single-scheme tensor-unit-normalized sections theorem separately to S and T, giving natural gammaS,gammaT and natural eS,eT with their normalization equations. That theorem is a construction from rhom_global_sections and natural tensor-Hom, with no new sorry.

Construct z at B as gammaS(RB), followed by the inverse additive adjunction Hom(unitS,RB) ≃ Hom(FunitS,B), precomposition with the monoidal unit isomorphism unitT -> FunitS, and inverse gammaT(B). These are additive bijections. Naturality of gamma and the adjunction proves naturality of z. Applying gammaT to z_B(QS(a.homEquiv(d))(x)) gives epsilon_m;F(gammaS(x));d by adjunction naturality in the source. This entire construction is proved in the private sectionsComparison helper.

Substitute the unit normalization equations for eT and eS. Naturality of qT in its first variable cancels its inverse on the evaluation transpose. Naturality of the tensorator moves F(gammaS(x)) across mu. The monoidal left-unit law cancels epsilon_m with the inverse left unitor. Finally naturality of qS in its first variable identifies (gammaS(x) tensor identity);qS(identity) with qS(gammaS(x)). Functoriality of F finishes the displayed equality. This is the fully proved private evaluationPullback helper. No representative calculation involving a scheme morphism remains.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved categorical argument through tensor-unit corepresentability. The new single-scheme unit-sections theorem is itself fully proved from rhom_global_sections and naturality of q. The sections comparison is constructed from the adjunction rather than derived-sections composition; no new hole remains.
